title: WaterSound "Happy Dunes" 99 Compass Point Way S #208
h1: WaterSound "Happy Dunes" 99 Compass Point Way S #208
description_expanded: HIGH HIGHLIGHTS:- Private Deeded Beach Access- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- Gulf-front- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout - This property comes with 1 designated parking space and 1 first-come first-serve parking space. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Gorgeous view of the natural dunes make this unit picture perfect. Enjoy the views from the round living area or out of one of the many windows this unit offers. Glimpses of the beautiful turquoise waters can be seen, offering a peaceful ambiance. The living area is open and airy and features a flat-screen television and plenty of space for your whole group. The kitchen and attached dining area offer plenty of room for meals together and great amenities for your chef at mealtime. This kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, beautiful cabinetry, black granite countertops, and all of the amenities you need to prepare a gourmet meal. The small office space just off the kitchen is perfect for your computer or a great workspace for business travel. The Primary Suite in this three-bedroom unit has a large king-size bed with a television. It offers beautiful dune views as well as access to the balcony. A private bath with double vanities and a large soaking tub and shower make this suite a perfect retreat. The second bedroom offers a queen bed and a twin bed and a pool view with a balcony. Enjoy the in-room television and bath with single vanity and shower. The third bedroom is 2 queen bed, as well as the pool view and bathroom.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8) FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Tub And Shower - Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom With Tub And Shower - Guest Bedroom: One Queen Bed and One Twin Bed, Shower OnlyIMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW*From October 2025 through 2026, WaterSound Compass Point will undergo major exterior refurbishment. Residents and guests should expect construction, boarded windows, limited balcony and garage access, and possible parking disruptions. These safety measures are essential for project completion.*HOA regulations do not allow for guest Low-Speed Vehicle rentals. Additionally, bringing your own Low-Speed Vehicle onto the property is prohibited.*This is a peaceful community. To ensure everyone's enjoyment, weddings, parties, gatherings exceeding a reasonable number of guests, and guests of guests are strictly prohibited. Violation of this policy may result in immediate removal from the property, forfeiture of any remaining rental fees, and potential fines from the HOA, community, and 360 Blue.* To ensure a comfortable stay for all guests, pets are not permitted on the property. Please note that any damage caused by pets will be the guest's responsibility.
